Marissa / team — quick tech notes and a minimal mapping to start.

1) Transport and endpoints
- Preferred production path: HEC over TLS (443) with mTLS. HEC gives field-level control and is easier for Splunk parsing. We support HEC batching and gzip compression.
- Alternative: syslog over TLS to an internal forwarder (useful for environments that prefer a forwarder appliance).
- Egress IPs: we'll provide a five-address block for allowlisting; for private deployments (VPC peering / private link) we can avoid public egress.

2) Log/trace format
- Logs: JSON-lines with canonical fields: timestamp, service, env, severity, trace_id, span_id, message, metadata (map).
- Traces: we can emit OTLP-compatible spans in a wrapped JSON envelope to preserve sampling headers; we include trace hooks on request/response boundaries.

3) Retention & replay
- We can stage raw bundles to S3-compatible storage in the customer's VPC for replay. Replay window configurable; default 30 days for raw bundles, with on-request longer-term export. For legal retention (7 years) we propose a managed archival export (encrypted, signed manifests) delivered monthly.

4) Evidence & audit
- We sign manifests and per-bundle checksums (sha256) and provide audit logs that show transfer start/finish and delivery ack.

I'll attach a small HEC mapping example you can drop into Splunk to validate fields: hec-mapping-example.json

Ben
Senior Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference

Adding compliance notes for procurement and audit.

- KMS/HSM: For private deployments we support customer-managed keys via KMIP-compatible HSMs or cloud KMS. We'll document key rotation and key access policies in the SOW.
- mTLS / CA: We can provision our side to accept a customer CA bundle. For longer-running contracts, we recommend a short-lived cert rotation schedule (90 days) and an automated rotation endpoint.
- Evidence retention: Redwood will retain transfer logs and manifests for 3 years by default in our private control plane; for 7-year legal retention we will provide monthly signed exports delivered to your archival bucket (encrypted with customer key).
- Data residency: confirm the destination region and whether data must remain in Acme's VPC (we support in-VPC staging to avoid any cross-region movement).
